chart.hint.title: The chart cannot be drawn
chart.hint.reason.tableMissing: No table named “{name}” exists in this document.
chart.hint.reason.tableMissingInFile: No table named “{name}” exists in the document “{file}”.
chart.hint.reason.tableNotNamed: The chart does not name a table. It expects the entry table with the name of the data table, for example table: Sales.
chart.hint.reason.tableOtherKind: The name “{name}” does not belong to a data table. A chart only shows the values of a data table.
chart.hint.reason.tableInvalid: The data table “{name}” reports an error in its structure. The chart appears as soon as the error in the table is fixed.
chart.hint.reason.selectionInvalid: The column or row “{entry}” is missing from the table or is not unique.
chart.hint.reason.selectionKeyMissing: The chart is missing the entry {key}, or its value is unknown.
chart.hint.reason.valuesNotNumeric: The column “{column}” is not a number column. The values of a chart only come from number columns.
chart.hint.reason.noNumbers: The selected data series do not contain a single number.
chart.hint.reason.typeNegative: A pie or donut chart cannot show negative values.
chart.hint.reason.typeZeros: A pie or donut chart needs at least one value greater than zero.
chart.hint.reason.typeMultipleSeries: A pie or donut chart shows exactly one data series.
chart.hint.reason.typeUnknown: The chart type is missing or unknown. Possible types are line, bar, pie and donut.
chart.hint.reason.notReadInTime: The table could not be read in time.
chart.omitted.one: 1 value was left out because its cell is empty or unreadable.
chart.omitted.other: {n} values were left out because their cells are empty or unreadable.
chart.dialog.singleSeries: A pie or donut chart shows exactly one data series.
chart.dialog.rowsSkipped.one: 1 row cannot be selected because its entry in the label column is empty or not unique.
chart.dialog.rowsSkipped.other: {n} rows cannot be selected because their entries in the label column are empty or not unique.
chart.dialog.title: Title (optional)
chart.command.cannotInsert: No chart can be inserted for this table. {reason}
chart.command.noTable: No data table is selected. The cursor must be in a data table, or the table must have been clicked.
chart.command.noChart: No chart is selected. The cursor must be in the chart block, or the chart must have been clicked.
chart.command.notEditable: Edit is switched off; the document cannot be changed here.
chart.command.changedMeanwhile: The table or the chart was changed while the dialog was open. Nothing was written.
chart.command.failedInsert: The chart could not be inserted.
chart.command.failedEdit: The chart could not be changed.
chart.command.reason.noNumberColumn: The table has no number column.
chart.command.reason.noSeries: No column and no row of the table yields a data series.
chart.command.reason.tableInvalid: The table reports an error in its structure.
chart.command.reason.tableUnclosed: The block of the table is not closed.
chart.command.reason.chartUnclosed: The block of the chart is not closed.
chart.command.reason.nameNotUnique: The name of the table occurs more than once in the document.
chart.command.reason.nameUnresolved: The name the table would receive could not be assigned to it unambiguously.
chart.command.reason.indexNotReady: The document “{file}” has not been found yet because the documents are still being indexed. Please try again in a moment.
